  booking_id, property_id, external_platform, external_booking_id,

)
SELECT 
  'ext_' || md5(property_id || external_booking_id),
  property_id::uuid, external_platform, external_booking_id,
  guest_name, check_in_date::date, check_out_date::date, 
  booking_status, booking_type, notes
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
  property_id text, external_platform text, external_booking_id text,
  guest_name text, check_in_date text, check_out_date text,
  booking_status text, booking_type text, notes text
)

DO UPDATE SET
  guest_name = EXCLUDED.guest_name,
  check_in_date = EXCLUDED.check_in_date,
  check_out_date = EXCLUDED.check_out_date,

-- Check for competing offers (pending deals for same property and overlapping dates)
SELECT 
  d.deal_id,
  d.contact_id,
  d.guest_name,
  d.guest_phone,
  d.guest_email,
  d.property_id,
  d.check_in_date,
  d.check_out_date,
  d.num_guests,
  d.total_amount,
  d.deal_status,
  d.created_at,
  d.channel,
  d.priority_score,
  d.notes
FROM deals d
WHERE d.property_id = $1
  AND d.deal_status IN ('pending', 'pending_offer', 'ai_conversation', 'negotiating')
  AND d.contact_id != $4
  AND (
    -- Check for date overlap
    (d.check_in_date <= $3 AND d.check_out_date >= $2)
    OR (d.check_in_date >= $2 AND d.check_in_date < $3)
    OR (d.check_out_date > $2 AND d.check_out_date <= $3)
  )
ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

options.systemMessage: You are a helpful vacation rental booking assistant. Use tools when needed to check availability and create bookings. Be conversational and helpful.

parameters.name: check_availability
parameters.description: Check if a property is available for specific dates. Returns available dates and pricing.

parameters.name: get_property_details
parameters.description: Get detailed information about a specific property including amenities, rules, and photos.

parameters.name: calculate_price
parameters.description: Calculate the total price for a stay including any discounts or fees.

parameters.name: create_booking_hold
parameters.description: Create a temporary booking hold and generate a payment link. Use when guest confirms they want to book.

parameters.query:
-- Accept the chosen offer and decline others
WITH accepted AS (
  UPDATE deals 
  SET deal_status = 'accepted',
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE deal_id = $1
  RETURNING *
),
declined AS (
  UPDATE deals 
  SET deal_status = 'declined_competing',
      updated_at = NOW(),
      notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || ' | Declined: Another offer was accepted'
  WHERE property_id = (SELECT property_id FROM accepted)
    AND deal_id != $1
    AND deal_status IN ('pending', 'pending_offer', 'competing_offer', 'ai_conversation')
    AND check_in_date = (SELECT check_in_date FROM accepted)
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT 
  a.deal_id as accepted_deal_id,
  a.guest_name as accepted_guest,
  a.guest_phone as accepted_phone,
  a.contact_id as accepted_contact,
  a.property_id,
  a.property_name,
  a.check_in_date,
  a.check_out_date,
  a.total_amount,
  a.channel as accepted_channel,
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    'deal_id', d.deal_id,
    'guest_name', d.guest_name,
    'guest_phone', d.guest_phone,
    'contact_id', d.contact_id,
    'channel', d.channel
  )) FROM declined d) as declined_offers
FROM accepted a

UPDATE offer_conflicts 
SET status = 'resolved_accepted',
    resolved_at = NOW(),
    resolution_notes = 'Owner accepted deal: ' || $1
WHERE property_id = $2 
  AND status = 'pending_decision'
  AND check_in_date = $3

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, action: 'accepted', deal_id: $('Parse Owner Callback').item.json.deal_id } }}

parameters.query:
-- Decline all competing offers for the property and dates
UPDATE deals 
SET deal_status = 'declined_by_owner',
    updated_at = NOW(),
    notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || ' | Owner declined all competing offers'
WHERE property_id = $1
  AND deal_status IN ('pending', 'pending_offer', 'competing_offer', 'ai_conversation')
  AND check_in_date >= $2::date
  AND check_in_date <= ($2::date + interval '1 day')
RETURNING deal_id, guest_name, contact_id, channel, property_name, check_in_date, check_out_date

-- Extend hold on all competing offers
UPDATE deals 
SET deal_status = 'on_hold',
    updated_at = NOW(),
    notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || ' | Owner requested 24h hold'
WHERE property_id = $1
  AND deal_status IN ('pending', 'pending_offer', 'competing_offer')
  AND check_in_date >= $2::date
  AND check_in_date <= ($2::date + interval '1 day')
RETURNING deal_id, guest_name

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, action: 'hold', message: 'Offers placed on 24-hour hold' } }}

parameters.description: Escalate emergency to appropriate responders

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  'stale_bookings' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM bookings
WHERE booking_status = 'pending_payment'
  AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'stuck_conversations' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM conversations
WHERE conversation_stage NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')
  AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'unresponded_maintenance' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM maintenance_tickets
WHERE status = 'new'
  AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
  AND urgency IN ('high', 'emergency')
